decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the separate clarification that the E and L must belong to the Hero V-defined proprietary alphabet.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that the Hero V defines the entire architectural vocabulary; the second-V height clarification does not otherwise change Hero V geometry.
The existing same-message MODIFY already includes the approved second-V geometry and hierarchy and the clarified proprietary-alphabet treatment among the assets to preserve.
Placing the second V below the Hero V and É accent preserves the existing shared peak-alignment rule and does not modify it.
The source does not change the requirement that the É accent be literally derived from the Hero V terminal.
The source changes the independently modeled second-V height hierarchy and focal role, not its approved geometric derivation, terminal construction, or right-arm reach.
The second-V height and hierarchy clarification does not change the wordmark's kerning or cohesive-reading requirement.
The source concerns letterform architecture and second-V hierarchy, not the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source does not alter the selected all-caps case treatment.
The design hierarchy clarification has no effect on accepted preview image formats or accessibility.
The source does not change the final production-ready asset handoff requirement.
